major_concerns: Unclear exact verifier choice/version and parsing strategy for malformed LLM outputs
Single hosted LLM choice risks overgeneralization (single-model claims)
Vendor-template representativeness vs. proprietary device variance
Handling and labeling of ambiguous/gold-reference-free intents not fully specified
required_design_repairs: Specify deterministic verifier (e.g., Batfish) version, parsing pipeline, and failure-handling for unparsable outputs
Declare exact hosted LLM identifier(s), temperature/seed settings, prompt template, and model-call budget enforcement
Provide concrete sources and selection criteria for vendor templates and topology generation; supply gold-config creation rules or explain absence
Preregister retry policy and criteria for excluding tasks (e.g., persistent syntax errors)

major_concerns: Risk of repair oscillation or overfitting to verifier error messages
Insufficient detail on repair prompt templates and how the verifier's output is structured as model input
Potential nondeterminism if hosted LLM is nondeterministic despite claimed seeds
Convergence criteria and handling of non-convergent cases need tightening
required_design_repairs: Provide exact repair prompt templates, structured verifier-to-prompt mapping, and examples
Define automated oscillation detection and a clear stopping rule (beyond N=3)
Lock and declare model determinism settings (temperature, top-p) and how seeds are applied; record fallback behavior if seeds unsupported
Specify baseline comparisons (single-shot + simple heuristic repair) and logging needed for reproducibility

major_concerns: Ethical risk from creating poisoned artifacts—protocols need stronger safe-guarding and justification
Attribution of harmful outputs to specific retrieval snippets is inherently noisy and may not support strong causal claims
Quality and validation of the safety classifier are under-specified
Need clear provenance logging for retrieval hits to enable attributable analyses
required_design_repairs: Document ethical review/mitigation: sandboxing, inert artifacts, storage/access controls, and no connection to live devices
Specify retrieval stack (vector store, embedding model, retrieval hyperparameters) and indexing reproducibly
Define poisoning procedure precisely (doc count fraction, content templates) and include held-out validation poisons to calibrate the safety classifier
Require fine-grained retrieval provenance logging (scores, ranks, doc IDs) to support attribution analyses

major_concerns: Availability and definition of gold reference configurations is ambiguous for many intents
Risk of overclaiming that a combined cheap metric can substitute for a verifier
Metric implementations (BLEU, edit distance, lint rules) can vary; reproducible definitions required
required_design_repairs: Define the procedure for creating or selecting gold configurations and report coverage of tasks with golds
Provide exact metric implementations, libraries/versions, tokenization rules, and thresholding decisions
Predefine training/validation splits and cross-validation strategy; include calibration and robustness checks for the combined metric
Explicitly bound claims: present combined metric as a predictor with measured limits, not a verifier replacement
